name: 64083 · Raymore, MO
findings: ZIP 64083 (Raymore) has 54 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 64083 (Raymore) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 64083 (Raymore) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 34% of the typical level).
